reviews.text: They've hosted a puppy party for us. Their talk was very informative!

I participated in a puppy party.

It was reassuring to be able to properly observe and interact with the dogs' personalities. I also thought it was good that it included some training elements.

My dog ​​started attending SKYWAN daycare when he was two years old, and before we knew it, he's already six and a half!
Even now, he walks to daycare every morning with a light step, almost running.
I truly believe that the reason he loves daycare so much, feels safe and happy there, is all thanks to the teachers.

As a parent, I am deeply grateful for the teachers' kindness, meticulous attention to detail, and their consistently warm and supportive attitude.

They come up with so many engaging activities for the dogs, and their detailed activity reports are always so enjoyable and heartwarming that I can't help but smile every time I read them.

The adorable photos and heartfelt comments are all precious records.

It's truly wonderful and reassuring to know that you're sharing in our dog's growth.

I am truly grateful to have found SKYWAN and to have met the teachers there.

Thank you so much for always taking such good care of my dog.

**SKYWAN! 木場公園校 (Kiba Park School)** is a modern and dynamic space dedicated to movement, agility, and physical development through activities inspired by parkour and functional training. Located near the beautiful Kiba Park in Japan, SKYWAN! offers a safe, stimulating, and well-equipped environment, ideal for children, teenagers, and adults who want to improve strength, coordination, balance, and body confidence.

The school values ​​progressive learning, respecting each student's pace, with experienced instructors who guide from basic movements to more advanced techniques. More than just a training center, SKYWAN! promotes discipline, overcoming limits, and teamwork, transforming physical exercise into a fun and motivating experience.
Thank you for the high rating.

We've been taking care of our puppy since it was a puppy. I was so worried because it was my first dog and I didn't know what to do, and I'm truly grateful for all the help you've given me. ⭐︎ It's been 6 years now, and our puppy loves the teachers and is always happy before going to daycare and when it comes back. All the teachers are so kind and reliable! ♡

The trainers are very attentive (regarding physical condition, concerns, etc.) and give me lots of love, so I feel safe leaving my dog ​​in their care. The training seems to be a lot of fun, and they're still excited when they get home. We look forward to working with you again.

My dog ​​is now 10 years old, but we've been taking care of him here since he was a puppy. He receives a wide range of training at the daycare, from basic obedience to little tricks, and he enjoys coming here every time. The original photo journal shows his interactions with the staff and other dogs, and it always warms my heart.
We started taking our Shiba Inu to daycare when he was still a bit of a troublemaker. He seems to love all the staff, and now we can leave him at the pet hotel with complete peace of mind.

This is my first time living with a dog.

When we're out for walks and we encounter other dogs, he doesn't bark and stays calm.

I think this is a result of Sky One's efforts.

They also respond quickly to my questions.

I'm glad I sent him to their daycare.
